subject.title: TUI PTY harness: /reset case flakes on CI (no resetSession RPC)

question: Should `/reset` remain blocked while the TUI reports a just-finished context-processing state, or should that state become resettable once no genuinely in-flight run remains?
rationale: The answer determines whether the correct repair is solely test synchronization or a behavioral change to the conversation-preservation guard.

options.title: Preserve the finishing-state guard
options.body: Keep `/reset` blocked until the run lifecycle is fully idle, and make the harness explicitly wait for that idle condition before submitting the command.

options.title: Narrow the reset guard
options.body: Allow `/reset` after response completion by excluding the finishing-context state, with regression proof that no active transcript can be replaced.

recommendation.title: Preserve the finishing-state guard
recommendation.body: Keep `/reset` blocked until the run lifecycle is fully idle, and make the harness explicitly wait for that idle condition before submitting the command.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects steipete to the merged reset lifecycle contract and the report’s concrete failure analysis.
